mapper.select:
select p.post_id as postId, p.post_name as postName, p.post_type as postType from sys_post p where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and not exists (select 1 from sys_dept_post dp where dp.post_id = p.post_id and dp.dept_id = #{query.deptId})
and p.post_name like concat('%', #{query.postName}, '%')
and p.post_type = #{query.postType}
order by p.post_type
mapper.insert:
insert into sys_dept_post(dept_id, post_id, is_default) values
(#{item.deptId}, #{item.postId}, #{item.isDefault})
on conflict(dept_id, post_id) do update set is_default = excluded.is_default
mapper.select: select dept_id from sys_dept_post where is_default = 1 group by dept_id having count(1) > 1

select p.post_name, COALESCE(dp.dept_id, 0) as dept_id, case WHEN dp.dept_id is null then concat('0-', p.post_id) else concat(d.dept_id, '-', p.post_id) end as child_id, case WHEN dp.dept_id is null then p.post_name else concat(d.dept_name, '/', p.post_name) end as content from sys_post p left join sys_dept_post dp on dp.post_id = p.post_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = dp.dept_id where p.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
